To 31 July 2026 the UK Boiler Upgrade Scheme had received 151,136 applications, issued 101,029 vouchers, redeemed 93,364and paid £661,303,000. The grant is £7,500 per heat pump, plus £1,500 off gas grid until March 2027.The US section 25C credit is not allowed for property placed in service after 31 December 2025.
Heatline is fictional. Every company, product, customer, traction and financial figure in this deck is illustrative.
